name: smwmusic-touhou-kaikeidou-marine-benefit-the-pot-sum-of-an-uncaptured-raccoon
title: Touhou Kaikeidou ~ Marine Benefit - The Pot Sum of an Uncaptured Raccoon
description:
Konoha Susanomori's theme from the water-themed Touhou fangame, Touhou Kaikeidou ~ Marine Benefit.

It's very Touhou-sounding, and very boss-sounding. But in the "aw yeah, let's go!" fun kind of way.

One loop of the song actually contains the whole song twice but with the addition of a harp, and absence of a couple of hihats.

Thank you VecchiaZim and Masterlink for helping me transcribe and fiddle around with the almost inaudible harp sections of the original.

versions.title: Touhou Kaikeidou ~ Marine Benefit - The Pot Sum of an Uncaptured Raccoon
